title: No mechanical guard that ticfac never imports or requires a ticks Go package
body: 6in set out to prove the dependency direction mechanically. The contract direction is checked (contracts check/verify-upstream) and ticks pins its removed verbs by test, but ticfac's 'never import a ticks Go package' lives only in .tick/config.md prose; today go.mod requires nothing from pengelbrecht/ticks, but nothing fails if that changes. A whole-repo test asserting go.mod has no github.com/pengelbrecht/ticks require and no package's deps include one closes it cheaply.
